name.ja: DMRG・テンソルネットワーク
name.en: DMRG and tensor networks
Stationary electronic Schrödinger equation

note.ja: 固定核・非相対論の電子固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。従来の水素型動径例を保持し、追加は1次元の箱/HOと3AO以下の2電子FCIに限定する。一般多電子系の直接解法や連続空間の厳密分子解の検証ではない。
note.en: Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic eigenproblems; add nuclear repulsion separately. Preserve the existing hydrogenic radial examples. Additional examples are restricted to one-dimensional box/HO and two-electron FCI in at most3AOs, not general many-electron direct solvers or continuum-exact molecules.

name.en: Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations

note.ja: 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式で、非局所交換を含む。既存のHe局所還元とH2のRHF例を保持する。追加は固定H2/H3+の最小2電子模型で、UHF式は別の対応模型に明示する。一般多中心分子、開殻の大域安定性、完全基底や一般相関法の保証ではない。
note.en: Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. New calculations cover only fixed minimal two-electron H2/H3+ models; UHF equations have their own mapped model. No general multicenter molecules, global open-shell stability, complete-basis or general correlated-method guarantee.

name.en: Local Kohn–Sham DFT

note.ja: 密度汎関数の局所KS代表形です。公開例は、球対称Heのスピン非偏極・Dirac交換のみLDAと、固定した周期He／He₂セルのLDA交換＋VWN5相関です。原子の動径実装と周期PySCFワークフローは別系列で、基底・境界条件・参照も異なります。各例の範囲は下の固定入力・検証記録で確認してください。GGA・hybrid・一般物質・励起状態まで検証した意味ではありません。
note.en: Representative local Kohn–Sham equations. Published examples cover spin-unpolarized exchange-only Dirac LDA for spherical helium and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation for fixed periodic He/He₂ cells. The radial atomic implementation and periodic PySCF workflows are separate series with different bases, boundaries and references. Inspect each input and validation record below; these examples do not validate GGA, hybrids, general materials or excited states.

name.en: Time-dependent Kohn–Sham equations

note.ja: 局所時間依存KSの代表形。初期状態、交換相関の記憶効果、断熱近似を区別する。実時間と線形応答の専用実装は未公開。
note.en: Representative local time-dependent KS equations. Distinguish initial-state dependence, exchange-correlation memory and adiabatic approximations. No dedicated real-time or response implementation is published.

name.ja: 水素型原子：解析解と格子収束
name.en: Hydrogenic atoms: analytic references and grid refinement

note.ja: 孤立した1電子のH・He⁺について、1s・2s・2p・3dのエネルギーと動径軌道を解析解と比較します。多電子原子や分子の直接解法ではありません。
note.en: Isolated one-electron H and He⁺: compare 1s, 2s, 2p and 3d energies and radial orbitals against analytic solutions. Not a direct many-electron or molecular solver.

name.en: Hydrogenic formulas and immutable finite-basis helium reference cards

note.ja: 既存H/Heの式と保存参照を、単位・規格化・模型の限界とともに示します。
note.en: Map existing H/He formulas and saved finite-basis references to units, normalization and model limits.

name.en: Small 1D box and quantum harmonic-oscillator eigenpairs

note.en: Compare low stationary eigenpairs of a1D box and harmonic oscillator, with finite-domain and mesh sensitivity.

name.ja: H₂分子RHF：独立参照・SCF・s型基底拡大
name.en: H₂ molecular RHF: independent reference, SCF and s-basis refinement

note.ja: 孤立・Born–Oppenheimer・非相対論・2電子閉殻H₂。3核間距離でSTO-3Gと入れ子s型Gaussian基底を比較。RHFの数値検証であり、分子DFT・周期系・完全基底極限や正しい解離を検証しない。
note.en: Isolated Born–Oppenheimer nonrelativistic two-electron closed-shell H₂. Compare STO-3G and nested s-Gaussian spaces at three separations. Numerical RHF validation, not molecular DFT, periodic, complete-basis or correct-dissociation validation.

name.ja: 周期HeのKS-LDA：Γ点・kメッシュ・基底・SCF
name.en: Periodic-He KS-LDA: Gamma, k meshes, basis and SCF

note.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセル（格子定数4 bohr、価電子2、非偏極LDA_X＋VWN5、局所GTH）。PySCFを使う実行・検証ワークフロー。11設定でk点・Gaussian軌道基底・FFT補助格子・SCFを別々に比較し、Γ／2³は独立DFTK平面波参照と照合。平衡He結晶・完全基底・金属・一般物質は未検証。
note.en: Fixed one-atom simple-cubic He cell (lattice constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. Eleven settings separately compare k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF; Gamma and 2³ are compared with independent DFTK plane waves. Equilibrium helium, complete-basis, metals and general materials remain unvalidated.

name.ja: 周期He₂の原子間力：解析力・有限差分・BOMD接続
name.en: Periodic-He₂ forces: analytic derivatives, finite differences and BOMD interface

note.ja: 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
note.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.
